searchText: Hey, I'm not sure if this is the right channel to ask this, but I'm trying to understand validator deposits after the merge / after shanghai. As far I understand, the deposit contract will still exist after the merge and validators will have the same flow there as right now. Is that correct? Looking at EIP-4895 (I know this is not finalized), withdrawals will later then be pushed to the withdrawal address as a balance change. Accounting for the ETH in the deposit contract, does that mean that by staking and unstaking I basically make 64 ETH out of 32 (32 new ETH on the withdrawal address and 32 inacessible in the deposit contract)? Nothing changes with regards to deposits or withdraws with The Merge. There is active research/development on withdraws, but that won't land on mainnet until sometime after The Merge (no timeline yet). For questions about EIP-4895, the best place to ask would be in the discussions-to thread (link at the top of the EIP). I believe there is discussion around whether we should care about the "total supply" of ETH becoming more complex to calculate or not. Thanks! I totally missed the discussion link at the top of the page! Will read through the track and ask any remaining questions there ✌️ i would not count eth in the deposit contract when calculating total supply
